title: Room export to transcript records
spec: Add exportRoom(room) to VenueClient in src/venue/export.ts as a standalone function exportRoom(transport, base, room): Promise<{ text, generation, records }>: GET /r/<room>/export, keep the byte-exact JSONL text, read the x-room-generation header, and parse with @flop-labs/tclk parseTranscriptExport. A non-2xx throws BadResponseError. Do not modify client.ts.
done: The recorded export parses into transcript records whose lines equal the JSONL text and the generation header is returned.
